name: Guide Gear Heavy-Duty Park Style Charcoal Grill Large
description: You don't have to pack up a cooler and go to the park for picnic-style barbecue. With the Guide Gear Park-style Grill you can have it right at home, whenever you want it! Modeled after the iconic grills found in parks across the country, it's made from long-lasting plate steel and designed for easy use. Adjustable height puts you in total control. Raise the grate for delicate cuts of meat, or keep it down low by the coals for a perfect sear. Thanks to 4 levels of adjustment, you can put the grate exactly where you need it. And when bad weather rolls in or winter's knocking at the door, the top comes off for easy storage, keeping it pristine for the next use. Heavy, .06 inch plate steel construction 4-level adjustable grate Included pole anchors into ground (concrete recommended) Grill unscrews from pole for storage Overall Grill Dimensions are 15.25 inch x 15.25 inch x 8 inchh. 256 sq.-in. grill surface Pole Dimensions are 50 inch long, 2.375 inch outer diameter Weighs approximately 41 lbs. Order today and bring the park to your yard! Size: large. Gender: unisex. Age Group: adult.
